integrity: Analytical proof given and finite linear-program/facet-rank experiments reproduced; experiments are not infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Canonical unweighted incidence-coordinate Euclidean metric; only graph joins of a clique and a chordless odd cycle with a>=2 and t>=1. Assumes published odd-cycle stable-set H-representation. No assertion for arbitrary graph joins, other metrics or ellipsoid problems. Priority remains provisional.
title: A quadratic tangency transition for stable-set polytopes of clique-joined odd cycles
